paragraphs: Rabbi Dostai bar Matton: Berakhot 7b; Megillah 6b. He reported Rabbi Yochanan: Yoma 30b. In the Jerusalem Talmud, chapter Merubbeh: Yusta bar Matton. In Zevachim 99a: Rabbi Yustai bar Matton said in the name of Rabbi Yochanan.
